_about: Machine-readable canon for Meridian value proliferation. Prose version: VALUE_CANONICALIZATION.md (2026-04-15). This file exists because that one is a stamp and cannot audit itself; check_canon.py recomputes from these primitives rather than string-matching. Audit that produced it: CS_AUDIT_2026-08-05.md.

eps1.source: corrected d=5 Seeley-DeWitt / Weyl decomposition, Ch4
eps1.note: pre-correction era used 0.017-0.018; those are DEAD, not alternative

Omega_m.note: F5 - ch5 uses this silently. The LOCKED pre-registration baseline at ch2:793 is 0.315, which gives c_s^2=213.1 not 216.6. If the registry baseline wins, this primitive changes and every derived value below moves with it.

spectral_chain_JC.note: F3 - ch5:135 attaches the label 'junction-condition benchmark' to w0=-0.865 instead. Two benchmarks, one label.

Ceff_band_lower.source: ch2:11 w0 locked in [-0.84,-0.89] across three orders of C_eff
Ceff_band_lower.note: this is what ch5:135 actually evaluates and mislabels as JC

HK_CMB.note: F2 - ch5's headline c_s^2~216 / c_s~14.7c is THIS benchmark, not the canonical one

boxed_range.VERDICT: FALSE as of 2026-08-05 - the printed range is benchmark_spread ONLY at eps1 fixed. See F1.

uncertainty_dominance.VERDICT: FALSE - comparable in c_s. See F4.

dead_values.note: F6: provenance not reconstructible from any formula on disk. Pattern is ASSERTION-shaped (c_s = 11.3c) on purpose: the honest lower edge of the LIVE range is also 11.3c (eps1+1sigma at the Ceff benchmark), a numerical coincidence with a dead value. A bare '11.3c' pattern flags the live range as dead -- it did, on 2026-08-05, in the very sentence of project_meridian_v5.md that states the correct range.

_role_rule: Classify by what the file IS, never by whether it currently passes. Reclassifying a file to silence a hit is the self-service silencer failure mode; if a CANONICAL file holds a dead value, fix the file.
